issues.observation: A near black foreground structural form still divides the right center of the wide image and breaks the hero action silhouette.
issues.desiredOutcome: Retain environmental depth while keeping unintended foreground occlusion below the rubric ratio across the hero silhouette.

issues.observation: Large same scale rectangular overlays occupy most of the medium subject and read as floating clutter rather than integrated structure.
issues.desiredOutcome: Use sparse contour following relief with bounded coverage and distinct primary secondary and tertiary scale bands.

issues.observation: The medium shot remains overfilled and the subject has no useful margin for reading the contact action.
issues.desiredOutcome: Fit the bound subject group to a measured occupancy interval with at least the rubric negative space margin.

issues.observation: The close image contains more plates but still lacks a dominant eye line and an ordered brow cheek jaw hierarchy.
issues.desiredOutcome: Create a shallow contour following faceplate hierarchy whose eye line reads first and whose brow cheek and jaw read at descending scales.

issues.observation: The attempted joint layers use box overlays and do not establish a mechanical core shell gap relationship.
issues.desiredOutcome: Build concentric contour aligned joint layers with visible gaps and three separated scale bands.

lesson.rootCause: The first executor treated minimum part and layer counts as quality and lacked screen space occupancy contour relief and density constraints.
